prompt:
The section sections/contact-panel.liquid currently renders only a heading and an email link, although its schema already lets merchants enter a phone number and add opening-hours blocks. Extend the markup so that it renders the phone number and the opening hours as specified below. Keep the existing {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Inputs (all under `section`; nothing else is top-level): - section.settings.heading: string or null - section.settings.email: string or null - section.settings.phone: string or null - section.blocks: array (possibly empty). Every block has `type` (string, e.g. "hours" or "holiday") and `settings` with the keys `day` (string or null) and `time` (string or null). Rules: 1. heading, email and phone are trimmed of leading/trailing whitespace (null counts as empty). A value is present only if it is non-empty after trimming. 2. Opening-hours entries: iterate section.blocks in order. Only blocks whose type is exactly "hours" are considered; all other block types are ignored. For a considered block, trim settings.day; if it is empty (or null) the block is skipped. Otherwise trim settings.time; if it is empty or null, use the text Closed instead. 3. If no heading, no email, no phone and no opening-hours entry are present, output nothing at all (empty string). 4. Otherwise output one `
` containing, in this order and only when present: - `

HEADING

` - `

EMAIL

` (unchanged existing behavior) - `

PHONE

` where PHONE is the trimmed phone and DIAL is the trimmed phone with every space, hyphen (-), opening parenthesis, closing parenthesis and dot (.) removed (other characters such as + are kept). - `
    ` containing one `
  • DAY TIME
    • ` per entry (a single space between and TIME), omitted entirely when there are no entries. 5. Every text and attribute value (heading, email, DIAL, PHONE, DAY, TIME) is HTML-escaped with the escape filter. 6. Produce no whitespace between tags: output is exactly the elements above concatenated, e.g. `

    Hi

    • Monday 9-5
    `. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/contact-panel.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
